craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of marshalled examples — parity and fencing. Whole Lord-made; mutual-use shaped. Rejected: (a) whole→world → killed: whole is total. Read aloud: SHAPED for-MU-tu-al-USE … RIGHT-ly LORD-made.

lines: Shaped for mutual use, locus-formed — that whole world, this —

reads_against.argmap: What whole is rightly Lord-made? → The mutual-fit world-whole is rightly Lord-made.
c1_essence: Stock examples turned: eye-fitness shows the higher self; smoke-fire proves khadira-wood by mere knowing (vv10-11).
The hetu fenced, others sifting, the whole Lord-made; helpers' strange way opened, pictured, and bounded; fancied spread refused (vv12-18).
